affiliations.date_precision: The Army record carries a 15 December 1944 entry date; actual work dates and the temporal relationship to OSS service are unestablished.
affiliations.research_notes: The official broad occupational group names no employer, workplace, accounting role or employment dates.

claims.claim_text: Creston P Clark has a confirmed match to the exact name and private identifier in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army row matches both indexed name and private identifier and records Army entry on 15 December 1944.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and distinctive full name are decisive.
claims.temporal_assessment: The record dates Army entry but does not date OSS service or the occupational category.
claims.match_notes: No employer or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred.

claims.claim_text: An official Army-entry record assigns Creston P Clark the broad occupational category Accountants and auditors; no employer is identified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: NARA's code list decodes the identifier-matched Army record's occupation value as Accountants and auditors.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier establishes that the Army row belongs to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The code was captured at Army entry on 15 December 1944; whether it was his immediate pre-OSS work is unknown.
claims.match_notes: Occupation remains distinct from employer and self-employment; no organization is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The only exact-name Army candidate for Calvin L Clark carries a different private identifier from the OSS index; the records remain unmerged.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The complete Army file contains one exact-name row, but its identifier differs from the number printed in the OSS index.
claims.identity_match_assessment: An exact common name and middle initial cannot override a direct identifier conflict; the candidate remains separate.
claims.temporal_assessment: The candidate Army row dates entry to 1 June 1942, but no source establishes that the row belongs to the indexed person or identifies an OSS chronology.
claims.match_notes: The candidate's Army occupation, location, grade and other fields are not transferred to the indexed person and are excluded from default analytics.

research_attempts.research_notes: All candidates remain private. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
